blocks.orig: The Signature Serengeti Luxury Tented Camp is nestled deep in the bush of central Serengeti National Park, along the Nyabogati River. This location provides year-round water for the animals and therefore offers great viewing opportunities. Set on wooden platforms, the luxury safari tents are all custom-made from the finest canvas and offer all the comfort you need. Wide king-size beds, a lounge area and an ensuite bathroom are part of the package. Outside, a covered veranda awaits you for game viewing, relaxing and admiring wonderful sunsets as all the tents are west-facing. In the dining and lounge tents, you can enjoy a cold drink and a healthy meal, or play one of their many board, chess, card or children’s games.
blocks.html: Tucked away in the bush of central Serengeti National Park, beside the Nyabogati River, you will find the Signature Serengeti Luxury Tented Camp in a spot with excellent game viewing, as the river gives the animals water throughout the year. Each luxury tent is made to measure from top-quality canvas, raised on a wooden deck and fully equipped for a comfortable stay, with a wide king-size bed, a seating area and a private ensuite bathroom. In front of each tent is a covered veranda for spotting animals, relaxing and watching beautiful sunsets, as all tents face west. Head to the lounge and dining tents for a healthy meal and a cold drink, or try one of the many games on offer, from chess, cards and board games to children’s games.
